lines.text: Welcome to the Cedar Health Clinics kickoff. Today we'll walk through the commitments and kick off implementation.
We're glad to get started. Our top priority is getting SSO live so our staff don't have separate credentials.
SSO is owned by me, target is fourteen days from today.
The CSV migration is critical too. Our patient scheduling data needs to come over cleanly.
Migration is on track, currently processing the CSV templates Cedar provided. We're targeting thirty days.
Good. We also discussed admin training. Our IT lead is ready.
Admin training is scheduled for the end of next week, two sessions as agreed.
There was also a mention of a custom scheduling workflow for our after-hours calls.
Workflow configuration is in scope, we're building that now and it's currently at risk due to a dependency on the patient data schema.
Anything we can provide to unblock that?
Yes, we need the final patient data schema document from your IT team.
Also, on the kickoff readback: we were promised a dedicated customer success manager for the first six months.
That's correct, Aisha Okonkwo will be your dedicated CSM for the first six months post go-live.
Perfect. Any other items we should track?
We're monitoring all items closely. I'll send a weekly status update every Monday.
